author: Ruohang Feng (rh@vonng.com)
description: RustFS cluster overview. RustFS is operated as a MinIO flavor and pushes native OTLP metrics to the first enabled VictoriaMetrics infra node.

panels.description: RustFS cluster identity. RustFS is managed as a MinIO flavor; version/environment are OTEL resource attributes and member count comes from independent readiness targets.
RustFS cluster members with stable Pigsty identity, OTEL version, independent readiness, telemetry freshness, and process load.
panels.title: RustFS Members

panels.description: Minimum result of independent HTTPS readiness probes.
Number of RustFS instances discovered by readiness probes.
Cluster-level offline server count reported by RustFS. Repeated node reports are deduplicated with max.
Online drives reported for this cluster.
Used divided by usable cluster capacity.
Cluster objects reported by the RustFS usage scanner.
Buckets visible to the cluster.
Minimum internal RustFS runtime readiness across all members of the selected cluster.
S3 operations and total HTTP transport request rate. HTTP includes health, admin, console, and internode traffic; S3 Operations is the application-facing subset.
panels.title: Cluster Load

panels.description: Active RustFS alerts. Click to open Pigsty Alertmanager.
Pigsty alert timeline: solid bands are firing alerts and pale bands are pending alerts. Click a series to inspect or silence it in Alertmanager.
panels.title: RustFS Alerts

panels.description: Cluster metrics are emitted by every node; max removes duplicate reports.
panels.title: Cluster Capacity

panels.description: Bucket usage is repeated by each node and deduplicated by bucket.
panels.title: Bucket Usage

panels.description: Object count by bucket, deduplicated across node reports.
panels.title: Bucket Objects

panels.description: External readiness, internal readiness, and OTLP freshness by instance.
panels.title: Node Readiness

panels.description: Read and write health for every erasure set. One is healthy.
panels.title: Erasure Set Health

panels.description: Read/write quorum, online drives, and data/parity shard layout.
panels.title: Erasure Layout and Quorum

panels.description: All RustFS HTTP transport requests, including S3, admin, health, and internode HTTP. This is not equivalent to MinIO's API-labeled S3 request metric.
panels.title: HTTP Request Rate

panels.description: 4xx and 5xx HTTP response rate by status class.
panels.title: HTTP Failure Rate

panels.description: Exact average from histogram sum/count. beta11's generic HTTP histogram buckets are too coarse for trustworthy sub-second percentiles.
panels.title: Average HTTP Latency

panels.description: HTTP request and response body throughput. Includes internode traffic handled by the same server.
panels.title: HTTP Body Throughput

panels.description: Capacity of every RustFS drive, deduplicated across the identical cluster-wide reports emitted by each member.
panels.title: Drive Capacity

panels.description: Internode operation rate by operation and direction.
panels.title: Internode Operation Rate

panels.description: Internode operation errors by operation.
panels.title: Internode Errors

panels.description: Scanner throughput by instance.
panels.title: Scanner Throughput

panels.description: Scanner cycle and bucket scan failures.
panels.title: Scanner Failures

panels.description: ILM and replication queues. Empty panels are expected when these features are unused.
panels.title: Background Queues
